standard-dialogue-before-starting-zogre-.npc: Hey...who gave you permission to come in here! Get out, get out I say.

standard-dialogue-before-starting-zogre-.player: Alright, alright...keep your night cap on.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-take-his.npc: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-use-tele.npc: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-zo.npc: Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-zo.player: Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.

options.text: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?

steps.player: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?

steps.npc: Haven't I already explained this to you once before?

Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.

steps.player: Yeah, clearly so what should we use?

steps.npc: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.

options.text: How do I get rid of the disease?

steps.player: How do I get rid of the disease?

steps.npc: Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?

steps.player: Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!

steps.npc: My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
